meta.title: Indonesian Civil Service, Police, and Military English Grammar Test

questions.question: In the sentence 'The Indonesian police officer patrols the neighborhood', what is the subject?
questions.explanation: The subject is the doer of the action. / Subjek adalah pelaku tindakan.

questions.question: Identify the predicate in the sentence: 'The TNI soldiers defend the nation's borders.'
questions.explanation: The predicate contains the verb and tells something about the subject. / Predikat mengandung kata kerja dan menjelaskan subjek.

questions.question: Which of the following is the direct object in 'The civil servant submitted the report'?
questions.explanation: The direct object receives the action of the verb. / Objek langsung menerima tindakan dari kata kerja.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The commander appointed him a lieutenant', what is the role of 'a lieutenant'?
questions.explanation: It renames or describes the direct object 'him'. / Ini mengganti nama atau mendeskripsikan objek langsung 'him'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The police officers is investigating the case
questions.explanation: Plural subject 'officers' requires the plural verb 'are'. / Subjek jamak 'officers' membutuhkan kata kerja jamak 'are'.

questions.question: What is the subject complement in 'The new governor is very competent'?
questions.explanation: It describes the subject after a linking verb. / Ini mendeskripsikan subjek setelah kata kerja penghubung.

questions.question: Identify the indirect object in 'The ministry gave the civil servants new uniforms'.
questions.explanation: The indirect object is the recipient of the direct object. / Objek tidak langsung adalah penerima dari objek langsung.

questions.question: What is the simple subject in 'The brave Indonesian soldier fought bravely'?
questions.explanation: The simple subject is the main noun without its modifiers. / Subjek sederhana adalah kata benda utama tanpa modifier.

questions.question: Which part of the sentence 'Jakarta is the capital of Indonesia' is the predicate?
questions.explanation: The predicate is the part of the sentence that contains the verb and provides information about the subject. / Predikat adalah bagian kalimat yang mengandung kata kerja dan memberikan informasi tentang subjek.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: She write the police report every day
questions.explanation: Third person singular subject requires the verb to end in 's'. / Subjek orang ketiga tunggal membutuhkan kata kerja dengan akhiran 's'.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'I ___ a dedicated civil servant.'
questions.explanation: 'Am' is exclusively used with the first person singular subject 'I'. / 'Am' secara eksklusif digunakan dengan subjek orang pertama tunggal 'I'.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The TNI troops ___ ready for the mission.'
questions.explanation: Plural subject 'troops' takes the plural verb 'are'. / Subjek jamak 'troops' menggunakan kata kerja jamak 'are'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The police station ___ closed last night.'
questions.explanation: Singular subject in the past tense uses 'was'. / Subjek tunggal dalam bentuk lampau menggunakan 'was'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'You ___ required to show your ID card to the military police.'
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'You' always takes the verb 'are'. / Kata ganti 'You' selalu menggunakan kata kerja 'are'.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'There ___ many regulations for new civil servants.'
questions.explanation: 'Many regulations' is a plural subject, so it requires 'are'. / 'Many regulations' adalah subjek jamak, sehingga membutuhkan 'are'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The military equipment were stolen from the base
questions.explanation: 'Equipment' is an uncountable noun and is treated as singular. / 'Equipment' adalah kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung dan diperlakukan sebagai tunggal.

questions.question: Choose the correct interrogative form: '___ the police chief in the office yesterday?'
questions.explanation: Past tense interrogative for a singular subject uses 'Was'. / Interogatif bentuk lampau untuk subjek tunggal menggunakan 'Was'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'We ___ proud to be Indonesian citizens.'
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'We' always takes the plural verb 'are'. / Kata ganti 'We' selalu menggunakan kata kerja jamak 'are'.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The suspect ___ not at the crime scene.'
questions.explanation: Singular subject in the past negative form uses 'was'. / Subjek tunggal dalam bentuk negatif lampau menggunakan 'was'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'I wish I ___ a police officer.'
questions.explanation: The subjunctive mood uses 'were' for all subjects in hypothetical situations. / Subjunctive mood menggunakan 'were' untuk semua subjek dalam situasi hipotetis.

questions.question: Which of the following is a positive (affirmative) sentence?

options.A: The TNI does not maintain national security.
options.B: Does the TNI maintain national security?
options.D: The TNI never maintains national security.

questions.explanation: A positive sentence states a fact affirmatively without negation or questioning. / Kalimat positif menyatakan fakta secara afirmatif tanpa negasi atau pertanyaan.

questions.question: Which of the following is a negative sentence?

options.A: The civil servant accepts the assignment.
options.B: Does the civil servant accept the assignment?
options.C: The civil servant does not accept bribes.
options.D: The civil servant might accept the assignment.

questions.explanation: A negative sentence contains a negation word like 'not'. / Kalimat negatif mengandung kata negasi seperti 'not'.

questions.question: Which of the following is an interrogative sentence?

options.B: The police did not arrest the suspect.
options.C: Did the police arrest the suspect?
options.D: The police will arrest the suspect.

questions.explanation: An interrogative sentence asks a question and typically starts with an auxiliary verb. / Kalimat interogatif mengajukan pertanyaan dan biasanya dimulai dengan kata kerja bantu.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The soldiers does not wear civilian clothes on duty
questions.explanation: Plural subject 'soldiers' requires the auxiliary verb 'do', not 'does'. / Subjek jamak 'soldiers' membutuhkan kata kerja bantu 'do', bukan 'does'.

questions.question: Convert to negative: 'The minister signs the decree.'

options.A: The minister do not sign the decree.
options.B: The minister does not sign the decree.
options.C: The minister does not signs the decree.
options.D: The minister not sign the decree.

questions.explanation: Present simple negative for third person singular uses 'does not' + base verb. / Negatif present simple untuk orang ketiga tunggal menggunakan 'does not' + kata kerja dasar.

questions.question: Convert to interrogative: 'The police patrol the streets.'

options.A: Do the police patrol the streets?
options.B: Does the police patrol the streets?
options.D: The police do patrol the streets?

questions.explanation: Use 'Do' for a plural subject in present simple interrogative form. / Gunakan 'Do' untuk subjek jamak dalam bentuk interogatif present simple.

questions.question: Which sentence is correctly formed as an interrogative?

options.A: Has the military deployed the troops?
options.B: The military has deployed the troops?
options.C: Has the military deployed the troops.
options.D: Does the military has deployed the troops?

questions.explanation: It correctly starts with the auxiliary 'Has' and ends with a question mark. / Ini secara benar dimulai dengan kata bantu 'Has' dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative form of 'He can drive the police vehicle.'

options.A: He do not drive the police vehicle.
options.B: He does not can drive the police vehicle.
options.C: He cannot drive the police vehicle.
options.D: He no can drive the police vehicle.

questions.explanation: 'Cannot' (or 'can't') is the standard correct negative form of the modal verb 'can'. / 'Cannot' (atau 'can't') adalah bentuk negatif standar yang benar dari kata kerja modal 'can'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Are the civil servants works hard?
questions.explanation: Present continuous interrogative requires the verb+ing form after 'are'. / Interogatif present continuous membutuhkan bentuk verb+ing setelah 'are'.

questions.question: Identify the positive sentence:

options.A: Indonesia does not have a weak maritime defense.
options.B: Does Indonesia have a strong maritime defense?
options.C: Indonesia has a strong maritime defense.

questions.explanation: It is an affirmative statement without any negation or questioning. / Ini adalah pernyataan afirmatif tanpa negasi atau pertanyaan.

questions.question: Which of the following is an uncountable noun in the sentence: 'The police need more information'?
questions.explanation: 'Information' cannot be counted individually and has no plural form. / 'Information' tidak dapat dihitung secara individu dan tidak memiliki bentuk jamak.

questions.question: What is the correct plural form of 'police chief'?
questions.explanation: Regular compound nouns form the plural by adding 's' to the main noun. / Kata benda majemuk reguler membentuk jamak dengan menambahkan 's' pada kata benda utama.

questions.question: Identify the countable noun in this context: 'The TNI has many bases across the archipelago.'
questions.explanation: 'Bases' can be counted (one base, two bases). / 'Bases' dapat dihitung (satu basis, dua basis).

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The ministry bought new furnitures for the office
questions.explanation: 'Furniture' is an uncountable noun and does not have a plural form with 's'. / 'Furniture' adalah kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung dan tidak memiliki bentuk jamak dengan 's'.

questions.question: Which of the following nouns is always treated as plural in English?
questions.explanation: 'Police' is a collective noun that is always treated as plural and takes a plural verb. / 'Police' adalah kata benda kolektif yang selalu diperlakukan sebagai jamak dan menggunakan kata kerja jamak.

questions.question: Choose the correct quantifier for an uncountable noun: 'The civil servant has ___ experience.'
questions.explanation: 'Much' is used with uncountable nouns, while 'many', 'a few', and 'several' are for countable nouns. / 'Much' digunakan dengan kata benda yang tidak dapat dihitung, sedangkan 'many', 'a few', dan 'several' untuk kata benda yang dapat dihitung.

questions.question: What is the irregular plural form of 'policeman'?
questions.explanation: The noun 'man' irregularly changes to 'men' in the plural form. / Kata benda 'man' secara tidak beraturan berubah menjadi 'men' dalam bentuk jamak.

questions.question: Which sentence uses an uncountable noun correctly?

options.D: The military provided a few equipments.

questions.explanation: 'Equipment' is uncountable, so it correctly uses the quantifier 'some' without an 's'. / 'Equipment' tidak dapat dihitung, sehingga secara benar menggunakan kata kuantifikasi 'some' tanpa 's'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: There are many criterias for joining the TNI
questions.explanation: 'Criteria' is already the plural form of the singular 'criterion'. / 'Criteria' sudah merupakan bentuk jamak dari bentuk tunggal 'criterion'.

questions.question: What is the singular form of 'phenomena' in the context of social phenomena in Indonesia?
questions.explanation: 'Phenomenon' is the correct singular Greek-derived form. / 'Phenomenon' adalah bentuk tunggal yang berasal dari bahasa Yunani yang benar.

questions.question: What is the comparative form of 'bad'?
questions.explanation: The table shows 'worse' is the comparative form of 'bad'. / Tabel menunjukkan 'worse' adalah bentuk komparatif dari 'bad'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The TNI is ___ than the local militia.'
questions.explanation: Comparative degree uses '-er' or 'more' when comparing two items. / Derajat komparatif menggunakan '-er' atau 'more' saat membandingkan dua benda.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'She is the ___ civil servant in the ministry.'
questions.explanation: Superlative degree for long adjectives uses 'most'. / Derajat superlatif untuk kata sifat panjang menggunakan 'most'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: This is the most hardest exam for police recruits
questions.explanation: Double superlative is incorrect. Use 'hardest' or 'most difficult'. / Double superlative tidak benar. Gunakan 'hardest' atau 'most difficult'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'Mount Semeru is the ___ volcano in Java.'
questions.explanation: Superlative degree is used when comparing one item to all others in a group. / Derajat superlatif digunakan saat membandingkan satu benda dengan semua benda lain dalam sebuah kelompok.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The new police regulation is ___ than the old one.'
questions.explanation: Long adjectives (3+ syllables) use 'more' for the comparative degree. / Kata sifat panjang (3+ suku kata) menggunakan 'more' untuk derajat komparatif.

questions.question: What is the irregular superlative form of 'good'?
questions.explanation: 'Good' irregularly becomes 'best' in the superlative degree. / 'Good' secara tidak beraturan menjadi 'best' dalam derajat superlatif.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The military base is farthest than the airport
questions.explanation: Use the comparative 'farther' or 'further' when comparing two things with 'than'. / Gunakan bentuk komparatif 'farther' atau 'further' saat membandingkan dua benda dengan 'than'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'Among all candidates, he is the ___ qualified for the civil servant position.'
questions.explanation: Superlative degree is used when comparing three or more items (among all candidates). / Derajat superlatif digunakan saat membandingkan tiga benda atau lebih (di antara semua kandidat).

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form: 'The Indonesian archipelago is ___ than many other countries.'
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the one-syllable adjective 'large' is 'larger'. / Bentuk komparatif dari kata sifat satu suku kata 'large' adalah 'larger'.
